# eDrumSynth: MicroDexed-touch's drum engine as an LV2 instrument
#
#   cmake -B build -G Ninja && cmake --build build && ctest --test-dir build
#   cmake --install build --prefix /usr     # -> /usr/lib/lv2/edrumsynth.lv2
#
# The TTL (edrumsynth.lv2/*.ttl, with the factory presets) and src/ports.h are generated by
# tools/gen_ttl.c and committed: cross builds don't run the generator.
# After changing the generator or the engine's tables:
#   cmake --build build --target regenerate
# No architecture specific flags here: they come from the build (CFLAGS).

cmake_minimum_required (VERSION 3.16)
project (edrumsynth VERSION 0.3.0 LANGUAGES C)

option (EDS_TESTS "build the tests (ctest)" ON)

set (CMAKE_C_STANDARD 17)
set (CMAKE_C_EXTENSIONS ON)		# gnu17: the engine needs C17 or older
set (CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
if (NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE AND NOT CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
	set (CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release)
endif ()

find_path (LV2_INCLUDE_DIR lv2/core/lv2.h)
if (NOT LV2_INCLUDE_DIR)
	message (FATAL_ERROR "LV2 headers (lv2/core/lv2.h) not found: install the LV2 development package")
endif ()
find_library (MATH_LIBRARY m)

# common/ (shared with the other plugins of mdt-lv2): the TTL helpers of the
# generator and the render test host
set (COMMON ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../common)
set (ENGINE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/engine/Synth_LXR)
set (ENGINE_SRC ${ENGINE}/src/lxr_engine.c ${ENGINE}/src/lxr_sequencer.c)
set (BUNDLE edrumsynth.lv2)
set (BUNDLE_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${BUNDLE})

# the engine: one translation unit with the firmware sources; their own
# include paths (they have a config.h) and no warnings (firmware code)
set (ENGINE_OPTIONS "-w")
# 32-bit ARM GCC knows the FX buffer's __fp16 only with an fp16 format (the
# Teensy build sets the same); elsewhere config.h maps it to _Float16
include (CheckCCompilerFlag)
check_c_compiler_flag (-mfp16-format=ieee HAVE_FP16_FORMAT)
if (HAVE_FP16_FORMAT)
	list (APPEND ENGINE_OPTIONS -mfp16-format=ieee)
endif ()
set_source_files_properties (${ENGINE_SRC} PROPERTIES
	INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${ENGINE}/lxr;${ENGINE}/lxr/shim"
	COMPILE_OPTIONS "${ENGINE_OPTIONS}")

# ---- the plugin ----

add_library (edrumsynth MODULE src/edrumsynth.c src/resampler.c ${ENGINE_SRC})
target_include_directories (edrumsynth PRIVATE src ${ENGINE}/src ${LV2_INCLUDE_DIR})
set_source_files_properties (src/edrumsynth.c src/resampler.c tools/gen_ttl.c tests/render_test.c tests/resampler_test.c
	tests/seq_test.c ${COMMON}/testhost/testhost.c
	PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-Wall;-Wextra")
set_target_properties (edrumsynth PROPERTIES
	PREFIX ""
	OUTPUT_NAME edrumsynth
	SUFFIX ".so"
	C_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden
	LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${BUNDLE_DIR})
# export only lv2_descriptor (and keep the engine's symbols to itself: the
# test host links its own engine)
include (CheckLinkerFlag OPTIONAL RESULT_VARIABLE HAVE_CHECK_LINKER_FLAG)
set (EDS_VERSION_SCRIPT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/edrumsynth.map)
if (HAVE_CHECK_LINKER_FLAG)
	check_linker_flag (C "-Wl,--version-script=${EDS_VERSION_SCRIPT}" HAVE_VERSION_SCRIPT)
endif ()
if (HAVE_VERSION_SCRIPT)
	target_link_options (edrumsynth PRIVATE "-Wl,--version-script=${EDS_VERSION_SCRIPT}")
	set_property (TARGET edrumsynth APPEND PROPERTY LINK_DEPENDS ${EDS_VERSION_SCRIPT})
endif ()
if (HAVE_CHECK_LINKER_FLAG)
	check_linker_flag (C "-Wl,--no-undefined" HAVE_NO_UNDEFINED)
endif ()
if (HAVE_NO_UNDEFINED)
	target_link_options (edrumsynth PRIVATE "-Wl,--no-undefined")
endif ()
if (MATH_LIBRARY)
	target_link_libraries (edrumsynth PRIVATE ${MATH_LIBRARY})
endif ()

# the bundle in the build tree (for the tests and LV2_PATH=build)
foreach (ttl manifest.ttl edrumsynth.ttl presets.ttl)
	configure_file (${BUNDLE}/${ttl} ${BUNDLE_DIR}/${ttl} COPYONLY)
endforeach ()

install (TARGETS edrumsynth LIBRARY DESTINATION lib/lv2/${BUNDLE})
install (FILES ${BUNDLE}/manifest.ttl ${BUNDLE}/edrumsynth.ttl ${BUNDLE}/presets.ttl DESTINATION lib/lv2/${BUNDLE})

# ---- the TTL generator (desktop only) ----

if (NOT CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
	add_executable (gen_ttl tools/gen_ttl.c ${ENGINE_SRC})
	target_include_directories (gen_ttl PRIVATE ${COMMON} ${ENGINE}/src ${ENGINE}/lxr ${ENGINE}/lxr/shim)
	if (MATH_LIBRARY)
		target_link_libraries (gen_ttl PRIVATE ${MATH_LIBRARY})
	endif ()
	add_custom_target (regenerate
		COMMAND gen_ttl ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${BUNDLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/ports.h ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/edrumsynth_ports.json
		COMMAND gen_ttl --symbols > ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/symbols.txt
		DEPENDS gen_ttl
		COMMENT "regenerating ${BUNDLE}/*.ttl, src/ports.h and tools/edrumsynth_ports.json in the source tree"
		VERBATIM)
endif ()

# ---- tests ----

if (EDS_TESTS AND NOT CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)
	enable_testing ()
	set (TESTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests)

	# the TTL and ports.h as committed == regenerated; the frozen symbols
	add_test (NAME ttl_regenerate COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
		-DGEN=$<TARGET_FILE:gen_ttl> -DSRC=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} -DOUT=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/regen
		-P ${TESTS}/check_ttl.cmake)
	add_test (NAME symbols_frozen COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
		-DGEN=$<TARGET_FILE:gen_ttl> -DFROZEN=${TESTS}/symbols.txt -DOUT=${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/symbols.txt
		-P ${TESTS}/check_symbols.cmake)

	# validation of the bundle (skipped without the tools)
	find_program (SORD_VALIDATE sord_validate)
	find_program (LV2_VALIDATE lv2_validate)
	find_program (LV2LINT lv2lint)
	# sord_validate with the LV2 specs (as lv2_validate);
	# common/zynthian-schema.ttl declares Zynthian's lv2:displayPriority
	set (LV2_SPEC_DIR /usr/lib/lv2 CACHE PATH "the installed LV2 specifications (core.lv2, ...)")
	if (SORD_VALIDATE AND EXISTS ${LV2_SPEC_DIR}/core.lv2)
		add_test (NAME sord_validate COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
			-DSORD=${SORD_VALIDATE} -DSPECS=${LV2_SPEC_DIR} -DSCHEMA=${COMMON}/zynthian-schema.ttl
			-DBUNDLE=${BUNDLE_DIR} -P ${TESTS}/check_sord.cmake)
	endif ()
	if (LV2_VALIDATE)
		add_test (NAME lv2_validate COMMAND ${LV2_VALIDATE} ${COMMON}/zynthian-schema.ttl
			${BUNDLE_DIR}/manifest.ttl ${BUNDLE_DIR}/edrumsynth.ttl ${BUNDLE_DIR}/presets.ttl)
		set_tests_properties (lv2_validate PROPERTIES FAIL_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "error:")
	endif ()
	if (LV2LINT)
		# warnings are errors (notes are not: no units, comments); online tests off
		add_test (NAME lv2lint COMMAND ${LV2LINT} -Mpack -Ewarn -I ${BUNDLE_DIR}/ "https://github.com/hjanetzek/mdt-lv2/edrumsynth")
		set_tests_properties (lv2lint PROPERTIES FAIL_REGULAR_EXPRESSION "\\[FAIL\\]|\\[WARN\\]")
	endif ()

	# the render test host: the plugin (dlopen) against the engine
	add_executable (render_test tests/render_test.c ${COMMON}/testhost/testhost.c ${ENGINE_SRC})
	target_include_directories (render_test PRIVATE src ${COMMON}/testhost ${ENGINE}/src ${LV2_INCLUDE_DIR})
	target_link_libraries (render_test PRIVATE ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
	if (MATH_LIBRARY)
		target_link_libraries (render_test PRIVATE ${MATH_LIBRARY})
	endif ()
	add_dependencies (render_test edrumsynth)
	add_test (NAME render COMMAND render_test $<TARGET_FILE:edrumsynth>)

	# the factory presets, and the kit converter's round trip (synthetic
	# kits; its bundle validated as the plugin's)
	find_package (Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter)
	if (Python3_Interpreter_FOUND)
		set (PRESETS_WORK ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/presets_test)
		add_test (NAME presets COMMAND render_test $<TARGET_FILE:edrumsynth> --presets
			"${Python3_EXECUTABLE} -I ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/snd2lv2.py" ${PRESETS_WORK})
		set_tests_properties (presets PROPERTIES FIXTURES_SETUP converted_kits)
		if (SORD_VALIDATE AND EXISTS ${LV2_SPEC_DIR}/core.lv2)
			add_test (NAME sord_validate_converted COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
				-DSORD=${SORD_VALIDATE} -DSPECS=${LV2_SPEC_DIR} -DSCHEMA=${COMMON}/zynthian-schema.ttl
				-DBUNDLE=${BUNDLE_DIR} -DDIR=${PRESETS_WORK}/kits.lv2 -P ${TESTS}/check_sord.cmake)
			set_tests_properties (sord_validate_converted PROPERTIES FIXTURES_REQUIRED converted_kits)
		endif ()
	endif ()

	# the LXR project converter (tools/lxrformat.py, tools/lxr2zynthian.py):
	# synthetic projects; the snapshot's keys against a zynthian-ui checkout
	# (ZYNTHIAN_UI) and the zynseq JSON through libzynseq.so (EDS_LIBZYNSEQ),
	# each skipped when not there
	if (Python3_Interpreter_FOUND)
		add_test (NAME converter COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} -I ${TESTS}/converter_test.py)
	endif ()

	# the sequencer: the ported LXR sequencer on the engine (triggers,
	# locks, kits, songs), the plugin's transport, panel and state against
	# it; with Python the LXR project converter (tools/lxr2preset.py)
	add_executable (seq_test tests/seq_test.c ${COMMON}/testhost/testhost.c ${ENGINE_SRC})
	target_include_directories (seq_test PRIVATE src ${COMMON}/testhost ${ENGINE}/src ${LV2_INCLUDE_DIR})
	target_link_libraries (seq_test PRIVATE ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
	if (MATH_LIBRARY)
		target_link_libraries (seq_test PRIVATE ${MATH_LIBRARY})
	endif ()
	add_dependencies (seq_test edrumsynth)
	add_test (NAME sequencer COMMAND seq_test $<TARGET_FILE:edrumsynth>)
	if (Python3_Interpreter_FOUND)
		set (PROJECT_WORK ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/project_test)
		add_test (NAME project_preset COMMAND seq_test $<TARGET_FILE:edrumsynth> --project
			"${Python3_EXECUTABLE} -I ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/lxr2preset.py" ${PROJECT_WORK})
		set_tests_properties (project_preset PROPERTIES FIXTURES_SETUP converted_project)
		if (SORD_VALIDATE AND EXISTS ${LV2_SPEC_DIR}/core.lv2)
			add_test (NAME sord_validate_project COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND}
				-DSORD=${SORD_VALIDATE} -DSPECS=${LV2_SPEC_DIR} -DSCHEMA=${COMMON}/zynthian-schema.ttl
				-DBUNDLE=${BUNDLE_DIR} -DDIR=${PROJECT_WORK}/song.lv2 -P ${TESTS}/check_sord.cmake)
			set_tests_properties (sord_validate_project PROPERTIES FIXTURES_REQUIRED converted_project)
		endif ()
		# the converted preset loaded with lilv, as jalv does (skipped without lilv)
		find_package (PkgConfig QUIET)
		if (PKG_CONFIG_FOUND)
			pkg_check_modules (LILV QUIET lilv-0)
		endif ()
		if (LILV_FOUND)
			add_executable (lilv_preset tests/lilv_preset.c ${COMMON}/testhost/testhost.c)
			target_include_directories (lilv_preset PRIVATE src ${COMMON}/testhost ${LILV_INCLUDE_DIRS} ${LV2_INCLUDE_DIR})
			target_link_libraries (lilv_preset PRIVATE ${LILV_LINK_LIBRARIES} ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
			if (MATH_LIBRARY)
				target_link_libraries (lilv_preset PRIVATE ${MATH_LIBRARY})
			endif ()
			set_source_files_properties (tests/lilv_preset.c PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "-Wall;-Wextra")
			add_dependencies (lilv_preset edrumsynth)
			add_test (NAME lilv_preset COMMAND lilv_preset ${BUNDLE_DIR} ${PROJECT_WORK}/song.lv2/testprj.ttl
				${PROJECT_WORK}/song.lv2.chunk)
			set_tests_properties (lilv_preset PROPERTIES FIXTURES_REQUIRED converted_project)
		endif ()
	endif ()

	add_executable (resampler_test tests/resampler_test.c src/resampler.c)
	target_include_directories (resampler_test PRIVATE src)
	if (MATH_LIBRARY)
		target_link_libraries (resampler_test PRIVATE ${MATH_LIBRARY})
	endif ()
	add_test (NAME resampler COMMAND resampler_test)
endif ()
